name: boniforce-credit-check
description: Get live Boniscores and credit assessments for German companies.

interface.longDescription: Automatically use Boniforce for German company Boniscores, credit-limit recommendations, risk assessments, ownership data, balance-sheet history, and financial analysis. The workflow reuses recent reports before spending 75 credits and authenticates every user through Boniforce OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Get the current Boniscore for this German company.
Check this company's credit limit and risk assessment.
